title: Everglades E-Bike Exploration with Airboat
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Everglades with a guided e-bike ride and thrilling airboat adventure. Start your day with a convenient bus pickup from North Miami before heading to Shark Valley Park. Enjoy a leisurely 15-mile e-bike loop through the park, where you’ll witness unique wildlife like alligators and diverse bird species. After the bike ride, indulge in a refreshing fruit snack and alligator bites while enjoying an assortment of beverages. Then, embark on an exhilarating 40-minute airboat ride through the wetlands, complemented by an informative nature show focused on local conservation. This tour is perfect for all fitness levels and offers a delightful mix of adventure and local flavors.

- Convenient bus pickup from North Miami to Shark Valley Park
- Guided 15-mile e-bike loop suitable for all fitness levels
- Refreshing fruit snacks and alligator bites provided
- Thrilling 40-minute airboat ride with a nature show included
